MindFlow · As of October 2026

The limits of AI.

Conversational AI. Offline on an iPhone.

MindFlow is my prototype of conversational AI for personal concerns. Responses are generated directly on an iPhone 15 Pro, using a Qwen language model and a LoRA adapter, without an internet connection. I develop the app and investigate how responses improve and where new errors arise.

The name describes my aim: a conversation that keeps flowing. This is a development goal, not a demonstrated psychological effect.
